title: Summary of Results and Structure of the QICT Closure Program
content: This document summarizes the logical structure and main results of the Quantum InformationCopy Time (QICT) closure program, assembling microscopic, algebraic, renormalization-group,phenomenological, gauge-theoretic, cosmological, and numerical ingredients into a single coherentframework. Under explicit hypotheses on the microscopic lattice model, on the functional renormal-ization group (FRG) flow, and on the scalar–neutrino sector, we state a sequence of theorems thattogether define a conditionally closed and falsifiable theory.
